title: From Trump to Julius Caesar through 266 popes
description: A Vatican visit, the line of popes, a Renaissance fresco and Rome's first emperors connect Donald Trump to Julius Caesar.
hook: How is Donald Trump connected to Julius Caesar?

image.file: File:Donald Trump Pope Francis Melania Trump in 2017.jpg

links.line: In May 2017, President Donald Trump visited Pope Francis at the Vatican.
